description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractDittoHeaders' that implements an immutable version of 'DittoHeaders'. It manages header key-value pairs, provides methods for retrieving specific headers and their types, handles authorization contexts, and supports serialization to JSON. It also includes methods for truncating headers based on size constraints.

classes.name: AbstractDittoHeaders
classes.description: An abstract immutable implementation of the DittoHeaders interface, managing headers with various retrieval and serialization methods.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the correlation ID from headers, if present.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type header as a string, if present.

methods.name: getDittoContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type as a ContentType object, if parseable.

methods.name: getSchemaVersion
methods.description: Obtains the schema version from headers as a JsonSchemaVersion object.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Returns a list of authorization subject IDs (deprecated).

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization context, handling issuer prefixes.

methods.name: getReadSubjects
methods.description: Returns the set of read subjects from a JSON array header.

methods.name: getReadGrantedSubjects
methods.description: Returns the set of AuthorizationSubject objects granted read access.

methods.name: getReadRevokedSubjects
methods.description: Returns the set of revoked AuthorizationSubject objects.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the channel header value.

methods.name: isResponseRequired
methods.description: Checks if the response is required based on headers.

methods.name: isExpectedBoolean
methods.description: Determines if a header's value matches the expected boolean value.

methods.name: getSpecificDefinitionByKey
methods.description: Abstract method to resolve header definitions by key.

methods.name: getBooleanForDefinition
methods.description: Deprecated method to resolve boolean headers.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Checks if the dry-run header is true.

methods.name: getOrigin
methods.description: Retrieves the origin header.

methods.name: getETag
methods.description: Gets the ETag header as an EntityTag object.

methods.name: getIfMatch
methods.description: Gets the If-Match header as EntityTagMatchers.

methods.name: getIfNoneMatch
methods.description: Gets the If-None-Match header as EntityTagMatchers.

methods.name: getInboundPayloadMapper
methods.description: Returns the inbound payload mapper header.

methods.name: getReplyTarget
methods.description: Returns the reply target header as an Integer.

methods.name: getExpectedResponseTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of expected ResponseType objects.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Returns a set of AcknowledgementRequest objects from headers.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Gets the timeout header as an Optional Duration object.

methods.name: getMetadataHeadersToPut
methods.description: Returns MetadataHeaders parsed from the put-metadata header.

methods.name: isAllowPolicyLockout
methods.description: Checks if policy lockout is allowed based on headers.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes headers to a JsonObject.

methods.name: getSerializationTypeForKey
methods.description: Determines the serialization type for a given header key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; headers are immutable.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; headers are immutable.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; headers are immutable.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; headers are immutable.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Provides a set view of the header entries.

methods.name: isEntriesSizeGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if the total size of headers exceeds a specified size.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Returns a truncated view of headers within max size constraints.

methods.name: getSortedEntriesByLength
methods.description: Returns header entries sorted by length, ascending.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: String representation of headers.
